items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: So that just went through the band like Grant went through Richmond.

ctx.x: Chester Lane, the piano player. So that just went through the band like Grant went through Richmond. But the people kept coming to the club and we kept playing those special requests. And they would say, 'Pillars,' we know you're doing the best you can. And we still love you and
we'll keep coming." And I was able to fill in with various musicians here and there, to keep the band going. But those were the highlights of 1942.
